headline: Brief Reports Senate Weighing Impeachment Schedule Changes as Budget Season Nears
seoTitle: Brief: Senate Impeachment Schedule and 2027 Budget
seoDescription: An FMB News morning brief reports that senators are considering calendar changes to balance the Sara Duterte impeachment trial with 2027 budget deliberations.
deck: The newsroom brief describes a possible split-day schedule for impeachment and budget work.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Earlier official and PNA records confirm that the Senate has repeatedly adjusted the Sara Duterte impeachment calendar to accommodate legislative duties, and that budget work was already expected to compete for chamber time.

The August 16 FMB News brief specifically reports a proposed 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. impeachment schedule followed by afternoon budget hearings. That exact split and the claimed August 18 NEP handoff remain source-attributed because a matching current PRIB release was not independently reproduced.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Senate's need to balance impeachment and legislative work is independently established; the exact August 16 split remains source-attributed.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Scheduling affects both a constitutional impeachment proceeding and Congress's obligation to scrutinize and pass the national budget.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for a Senate caucus decision, PRIB advisory and Finance Committee calendar.
